newsitem.title: UK: NORWICH EDGES HIGHER, DEMAND PICKS UP.
newsitem.headline: NORWICH EDGES HIGHER, DEMAND PICKS UP.

text.p: Shares in British insurance group Norwich Union Plc, were the most actively traded in London on Wednesday as funds sought to increase their weightings, dealers said.
"It is the stock of the day," said one market maker. "Funds are underweight."
By 0950 the stock was trading up 6-1/2p at 327p. With over six million shares traded, it stole the number one place in volume on the London Stock Exchange.

Earlier, the company announced it would join the official list of the Irish Stock Exchange on August 14. The stock is expected to join the FTSE 100 index at the next reshuffle in September, securing demand from index tracking funds.
